about: Paths in file and dark_file are relative to the report page folder (agent-scripting-runtimes/). dark_file is the project's official variant for dark surfaces. Entries with fallback_of reuse another entry's file instead of a copy. low_contrast_on lists surfaces where the mark nearly disappears and no official variant fixes it, by a computed rule checked in review: on dark, under 40% of the mark has 2:1 luminance contrast; on light, under 35% of it differs visibly (1.5:1 contrast or a clear color difference). brand_hex is the brand color Simple Icons publishes, or devicon's when Simple Icons has none or lists plain black or white, otherwise the saved file's dominant fill; null for multi-color gradient marks.
